_comment: Provenance for the 2 schemes imported from github.com/chandanshukla1989/fmm_decompositions by UpstreamSchemeRepos.SHUKLA on 2026-11-24, audited 2026-11-25. No licence file; the README offers the coefficient data for free reuse with attribution. Files are RE-ENCODED in the catalog's canonical format (coefficients unchanged).
discovery_note: Chandan Shukla, Verified bilinear decompositions for three small matrix formats, github.com/chandanshukla1989/fmm_decompositions (2026-11-09) — coefficient data offered for free reuse with attribution. Integer non-commutative scheme (coefficients bounded by 2), valid over every ring. Audit 2026-11-25: ⟨14,18,19⟩ 2829 (FMM-Lille and this catalog held 2890) and ⟨10,19,24⟩ 2723 (2754), each below the author's closure of fmm_sota.json (2026-11-06) under direct sums, Kronecker products and the projection-along-mode lemma; FMM-Lille cites Shukla:2026aa for both formats; each was strictly below this catalog's ℚ rank at import. The author states these are upper bounds built from published components — for these two formats, schemes of Perminov taken from this catalog (commit 71920f6b) — by merging the outer terms that share a w-vector into one larger inner product.
notes: Re-encoded from the upstream rank-row sparse JSON (dimensions, rank, u, v, w; scale 1) into the catalog's canonical format — no coefficient was changed. Credit Chandan Shukla (ORCID 0009-0008-0897-4332). The repository's third scheme, ⟨10,13,36⟩=2786, is past this catalog's dimension range and is not imported.
